Ecuador
Consular help:Consular help will be provided bythe Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in Washington or bythe Consulate General in Chicago, USA.
A visa is required for the following types of travel documents for BIH citizens:
Regular Passport NO Up to 90 days
Regular biometric Passport NO
Official biometric Passport NO
Diplomatic biometric Passport NO
Citizens of the Republic of Ecuador require a visa to enter, exit or pass through the territory of Bosnia and Herzegovina. Visas are issued in Washington or Chicago, USA.
